Package com.vuzix.licensing

Class Licensing

java.lang.Object
com.vuzix.licensing.Licensing
public class Licensing extends Object
The Licensing API allows you query for Vuzix App Store subscription status. You will need to obtain and provide your secret key which is available from your Vuzix App Store listing. This library has both synchronous and asynchronous interfaces to allow flexible integrations. The synchronous interfaces may only be called from background threads. Asynchronous callbacks will be invoked on the main UI thread.

      public void validateSubscription(ValidateOptions options, Licensing.Callback callback)
      Validates a subscription asynchronously, returning results via the provided callback. The provided ValidateOptions object is used to customize how the subscription is validated. Callback methods will be invoked on the main UI thread.
      Parameters:
      options - the desired options
      callback - the callback to which results are returned
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if options or callback is null

    • validateSubscription

      public ValidateResult validateSubscription(ValidateOptions options) throws ValidateException
      Validates a subscription synchronously. The provided ValidateOptions object is used to customize how the subscription is validated. This method must be called from a background thread, otherwise an IllegalStateException will be thrown.
      Parameters:
      options - the desired options
      Returns:
      the validate results
      Throws:
      ValidateException - if an error occurs
      IllegalStateException - if called from main UI thread
